definitions.explanation: A path or road used to guide movement, especially the paved surface at an airport connecting runways to terminals and hangars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{誘導路|ゆうどうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移動|いどう}している→移動する：22430_idousuru⟧。
examples.english: The airplane is moving along the taxiway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{機体|きたい}→機体：17883_kitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誘導路|ゆうどうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The landed aircraft headed to the terminal via the taxiway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拡張工事|かくちょうこうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{誘導路|ゆうどうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new taxiway was built as part of the airport expansion project.

notes:
{誘導路|ゆうどうろ} is primarily used in aviation to refer to taxiways at airports. Outside of aviation, it can also refer to any guiding path designed to direct the flow of traffic, people, or materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誘導路|ゆうどうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{地上走行|ちじょうそうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to taxi on the taxiway
- ⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧{誘導路|ゆうどうろ} — high-speed taxiway
- ⟦{平行|へいこう}→平行：05445_heikou⟧{誘導路|ゆうどうろ} — parallel taxiway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧ — runway (the strip used for takeoff and landing)
- ⟦エプロン→エプロン：10725_epuron⟧ — apron (the paved area where aircraft are parked and serviced)
